liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Reviewer says this version alone justifies downloading the show; Reviewer calls it incredible, with Phil's bass bombs making the balcony shake [11][14][16]
- **Touch of Grey** (2 reviews): Jerry forgot the lyrics, signaling to the reviewer it would be a good night; Reviewer found opening with this song into B.I.O.D.T.L a different way to start [14][20]
- **Birdsong** (1 review): Reviewer thinks it falls apart and never regains its earlier momentum [10]
- **Box of Rain** (1 review): Reviewer finds Phil's attempt at the vocal amusing [19]
- **B.I.O.D.T.L** (1 review): Reviewer says it is very well played with good energy [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Childhood's End**: rare: 13 archived performances [22]
- **Electronic Percussion**: rare: 12 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-10-03.132411.nak300.andrewf.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 158 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd94-10-03.pmb.pujol.15112.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 159 min; rated 3.89/5 by 19 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording's sound good; From a rear balcony seat opposite the stage, the reviewer found the sound surprisingly great; Reviewer finds it sounds much better than they remembered from the show [10][14][16][17]
- **gd1994-10-03.akg460.flaschner.sobel.84388.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 159 min [5]
- **gd1994-10-03.140244.FOB.Schoeps.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 165 min [3]

## Around the show

- Attendee says this was the last Dead show at the Garden, with a crowd that was really into it [11]
- Reviewer recalls the band's energy as off and on, with the end of the road nearing [17]
- Reviewer says Jerry tried hard while the rest of the band pushed him, with mixed results [20]
- Reviewer still keeps some of the heavy plastic beer cups served during that final Boston run [21]
- Reviewer finds the setlist stronger than the playing, though still a decent close to the Garden run [15]
- Reviewer says that, given 1994 was a weak year, this Garden run was pretty good [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-10-03.132411.nak300.andrewf.flac1644**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Casio DA-7 > TDK DC4 DAT. Mics on 7-foot stand, end of floor, center & straight back by the hockey wall. [1]. Also: Ted Carpenter loaned his microphones and stand for this run's taping, using Nak 300 mics [1]
- **gd94-10-03.pmb.pujol.15112.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Dave Minor; transferred by Marc Pujol; source: Audience: PMB Microphones [2]
- **gd1994-10-03.akg460.flaschner.sobel.84388.flac16**: taped by Dave Flaschner and Tom McMinn; transferred by Jason Sobel; source: AKG 460B/ck61 > custom pre-amp > Teac DA-P20 > Sony D7 (@ 48 kHz) [5]. Also: Master DAT, borrowed from Dave, was recorded with pre-emphasis and de-emphasized using a Waves Q10 EQ plug-in; One minor dropout on the master DAT was patched using a PMB microphone source via Sony D7 at 48k [5]
- **gd1994-10-03.140244.FOB.Schoeps.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Rich Gastwirt's Master Audience Dat recording: Schoeps CMC4 MK4> Panasonic SV-255> DAT (48k) (FOB); Charlie Miller [3]
